tweetText: Apple unveiled a new Siri AI powered by Google, but it’s not accessible to everyone worldwide. This move highlights the growing competition in AI tech and raises concerns about global access. via AI News

McDonald's is testing a new AI drive-thru ordering system called ArchIQ, backed by Google, at five locations in the U.S. This could revolutionize fast food ordering and improve efficiency. via AI News
OpenAI is backing the EU's Code of Practice on AI to enhance transparency and help users identify AI-generated content. This move aims to build trust in AI technology across Europe. via OpenAI News
You can now access OpenAI models and Codex through Oracle Cloud by using your existing commitments. This collaboration enhances enterprise security and governance for AI deployment. via OpenAI News

A new report reveals that PRC-linked influence operations are using AI to manipulate U.S. discussions on tech issues and spread misinformation about ChatGPT. This highlights the growing concern over foreign interference in critical technology debates. via OpenAI News

Opendoor is exiting India, sparking discussions about the role of AI in outsourcing. This move highlights the shifting dynamics in the global market as India becomes a key player in tech services. via TechCrunch AI

Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei now has just one direct report, highlighting his unique leadership style in AI. This streamlined structure could drive innovation and agility in the rapidly evolving tech landscape. via TechCrunch AI

A former xAI engineer claims he was fired for warning about safety issues with Grok just before SpaceX’s IPO. This raises serious questions about AI safety protocols at major tech firms. via TechCrunch AI

Amazon just borrowed $17.5B from banks after a bond sale to fuel its AI investments. This reflects the intense financial pressure companies face to stay competitive in the booming AI market. via TechCrunch AI

AI-focused companies are shelling out about $7,500 per employee each month on AI tools. This investment shows how seriously businesses are taking AI to boost productivity and stay competitive. via TechCrunch AI
